do I use it properly the very first time?

Here's how to get started with your new Carry-On on day one:



Set the dials to 0-0-0, which is the default combination, then slide the latch toward the dials to release the zipper pulls from the lock.


If the zipper pulls feel stuck, gently press them inward toward the lock while sliding the latch, since they can be tight from packaging.


Check for any cardboard inserts near the lock area and remove them before trying again.


Once the zipper pulls are free, unzip and open it up.



When you're ready to set your own combination, you can follow our lock setup guide for polycarbonate suitcases.
